rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something huge or for a major effect or degree.

example.english: That rainstorm had an immense impact and brought the whole city to a standstill.
example.traditional: 嗰場暴雨搞到全城停擺，個影響好大。
example.jyutping: go2 coeng4 bou6 jyu5 gaau2 dou3 cyun4 sing4 ting4 baai2 go3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this when “immense” means a large quantity or number rather than physical size.

example.english: We need an immense amount of money for this trip.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 jiu3 jung6 hou2 do1 cin4

rows.note: Use this colloquially when “immense” means exceptionally good or impressive.

example.english: That singer’s live performance was immense.
example.traditional: 嗰個歌手現場表演真係勁。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 go1 sau2 jin6 coeng4 biu2 jin2 zan1 hai6 ging6
